description: Boot an app class headless in Chromium against the local backend (?app_start=<class>) and LOOK at it: returns booted/ok, real page errors + failed backend calls (benign UI5 noise filtered; a repeated one listed once with its count, at most 20 distinct - `errorsCut` counts the rest; UI5 itself not loading - the CDN out of reach - is an error that says so, a theme or library that did not load a `ui5` note), and a full-page screenshot as an image (a page taller than 4096 px is pictured to that height, `screenshotCut` says so; the PNG is also saved and its path is `screenshot`, or `screenshotNotSaved` says why not). The RUNNING app, so it is the only tool that sees what the ABAP does — the data a SELECT fetched, what an event changes — and it needs a build_backend first. To look at the view alone while writing it, screenshot_view answers in seconds with no build at all. Also works for the existing ports and z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_overview.

class_name.description: the app class to start, e.g. zcl_my_app, z2ui5_cl_my_app or z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_005

timeout_ms.description: boot timeout in ms (default 60000, between 5000 and 600000)

name: run_app
